title: Why the Dutch Wait Less at Traffic Lights
summary: Not Just Bikes explains how Dutch traffic lights use early detection, transit priority and conflict-free design to cut waiting. The aim is to move as many people as possible rather than as many cars.
why: Used as the standard reference for what genuinely smart traffic signals look like, in threads about traffic engineering and self-driving cars.
